message: 避けられぬ決戦

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Azel!」
Taking the final blow, Azel's knees buckle.
And just like that, he collapses face-down.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! Hang in there!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Azel...」
We rushed over and cradled Azel's body.

name: Azel
message: 「Never mind... me...」

name: Azel
message: 「The sky... What happened to Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「The sky...?」

name: Azel
message: 「My eyes are blurry... I cannot see...」
Azel's eyes were open.
Large tears were overflowing from those eyes.

name: Lolotte
message: 「No way...!」

name: Synn
message: 「The shooting stars... won't stop...!」

name: Azel
message: 「I see... So Re-Crea is still... wandering...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it searching for a new host... Heh, what a stubborn thing...」

name: Azel
message: 「I suppose that makes sense... For so long, it has lived... solely to regenerate the world... after all...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Azel... Could it be...!」

name: Azel
message: 「My body is heavy... Heavy as lead... Yet...」

name: Azel
message: 「My heart has grown lighter...」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean...」

name: Azel
message: 「Re-Crea has abandoned me. Now, as long as no one else like me appears... Hmph」
Azel mocks himself.

name: Azel
message: 「When Re-Crea dwelled within me, I reveled in the joy」

name: Azel
message: 「I felt proud that I was a special existence... chosen by the Lord.」

name: Azel
message: 「So it isn't that I had a change of heart... Truthfully, I didn't want to betray Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, my heart was not strong at all... To be swayed by others to this extent...」

name: Azel
message: 「A being like me... a weak being... After all, Re-Crea could have dwelled within anyone...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That isn't true at all. If it weren't someone of your caliber, Azel-san, such drastic measures... could never have been taken.」

name: Azel
message: 「Spare me your comfort... I... I've already... ugh... lost... everything...」
And then they turn into tears of remorse.
Azel feels bitter regret. That his will was obstructed.
That he lost his qualification as the vessel of Re-Crea.
Truthfully, he is full of frustration and sorrow.
It is not a matter that can be decided by right or wrong, good or evil.
Giving up on the rebirth of the world like this... was the ultimate humiliation for Azel.

name: Lolotte
message: 「But, Azel-san... you haven't lost anything at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You have us... That alone will never change.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... guh... uuugh...」

name: Azel
message: 「Hic... forgive me... I can't hear well... come closer...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san...」
Had all five of Azel's senses weakened in exchange for reclaiming 'Azel's own heart'?

name: Lolotte
message: 「But right now, you're... alive and safe like this!」
Lolotte tightly embraced that completely emaciated body.
As if to make that fleeting existence certain...
Even after calming down a little, Azel could barely even stand on his own.
Combined with the battle against the Crusaders and the price of losing his qualification as Re-Crea's vessel, his body must have been exhausted to its absolute limit.

name: Azel
message: 「I... am thinking of returning to Heaven.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Indeed... At this rate, let alone maintaining an etheric state, even keeping a physical form will...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I believe it would be best for Azel-san to recuperate in Heaven.」

name: Azel
message: 「No. I am returning to atone for my sins...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sins...」

name: Azel
message: 「I conspired with the Demon and exploited Re-Crea. My sin runs deep...」

name: Synn
message: 「B―But we're the only ones who know that truth! You don't have to take it all on yourself―」

name: Azel
message: 「Either way, I must submit a report on the investigation once we return. There's no way I could conceal my crimes then.」

name: Azel
message: 「I must face judgment. And if I can manage to fully atone for it...」

name: Azel
message: 「Then I'll be able to stay friends with Lolotte and the others forever, you see」
